catalysts.title: Early Alert: Compact Medical Removes and Updates Use Instructions for ButterflyBVM Bag-Valve-Mask Resuscitators

findings.summary: FDA issued an Early Alert on an Urgent Medical Device Recall by Compact Medical of certain ButterflyBVM bag-valve-mask resuscitator lots. Lots 000109-000117 are to be removed from use and distribution, and lots 000081-000108 (ButterflyBVM, READY, PLUS, and standard models) are subject to a pre-use test and correction, due to possible holes in the bellows that can cause inadequate ventilation. As of November 2, 2026, no serious injuries or deaths had been reported.
